'''Seamus Kaldo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] from [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. His [[Seamus Kaldo's father|father's]] life's work, [[Engine/Legends|engine]] schematics, were once stolen from his family by [[Nico Okarr]], leading Seamus to attempt to track down the infamous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and seek revenge. While this was not initially successful, he eventually came upon his quarry by accident; unknowingly hiring him in the [[Sarlacc and Loaded cantina]] on [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]] while Nico was under the alias of "Snare". After trying to persuade "Snare" to help him on his quest, "Snare" revealed that he was in fact Nico Okarr. When Seamus and his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Vhonu]], attempted to apprehend the newly revealed smuggler, Nico shot them both with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on [[Stun/Legends|stun]].<ref name="Vacation" />
